body_markdown:
From **1 – 12 October** , shop at Homestolife Marina Square and unlock exclusive rewards and perks.


🎁 **Spend & Be Rewarded**


- Spend $3,999 → FREE Apple HomePod (worth $433)


- Spend $999 → FREE Apple AirTag (worth $45) OR $30 OFF


🛋️ **More Free Perks**


- FREE Leather Care Kit (min. $2,000 spend)


- FREE Fabric Care Kit (min. $1,200 spend)


- FREE Sofa Disposal (worth up to $180)


- FREE Delivery (worth up to $100) on sofas


- FREE 2 Pillows (worth $118) with any sofa


🏁 Don’t miss this **limited-time promotion only at Marina Square** . Upgrade your home with unbeatable value, premium tech giveaways, and hassle-free perks!


*Applicable to MTO sofas. While stocks last. T&Cs apply.*


📍 **Getting Here (1–12 Oct)**
Roads around Marina Bay will have[limited access](https://www.lta.gov.sg/content/dam/ltagov/news/press/2025/250926_Road_access_and_PT_guide_AnnexA.pdf) during F1.[Best way](https://www.marinasquare.com.sg/directions?categories=GettingHere-Web) to reach us is via public transport:


**By MRT:**


- *City Hall MRT Station (NS25 / EW13)* , and walk through CityLink Mall to reach Marina Square
- *Esplanade MRT Station (CC3)* , and access Marina Square via our basement integrated walkway - Marina Link


- *Promenade MRT Station (CC4 / DT15* ) and walk through Millenia Walk to reach Marina Square (exit from Millenia Walk’s entrance facing Raffles Boulevard and get on the escalator to Level 2).


**By Bus:**


- *Temasek Boulevard (Suntec Convention)*


36, 36B, 70A, 70M, 97, 97E, 106, 111, 133, 162M, 502, 502A, 518, 518A, 531, 700A, 857, 868


If you are driving or taking a taxi, the best way to get to Marina Square **is via Rocher Rd, exit from ECP, parking at Suntec City or Millenia Walk Shopping Center and walk over to Marina Square.**
